# fundament_organization_member (Resource)

Manages an organization member in Fundament. Invites a user by email and manages their permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fundament_organization_member" "example" {
  email      = "colleague@example.com"
  permission = "viewer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the member to invite. Changing this will destroy and recreate the member.
- `permission` (String) The permission of the member. Valid values are "admin" and "viewer".

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The timestamp when the member was created.
- `external_id` (String) The external identity provider ID. Set when the user authenticates.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the member.
- `name` (String) The display name of the member. Initially set to the email, changes when the user accepts the invite.
- `user_id` (String) The user ID (users.id) of the member.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import fundament_organization_member.example <member-id>
```
